title: John Allwright Fellowship
official_source: Australian Centre for International Agricultural Research (ACIAR)
duration: Offered for the minimum period necessary for the individual to complete the academic program specified by the Australian higher education institution, including any preparatory training
description: The John Allwright Fellowship (JAF) is a competitive, merit-based postgraduate scholarship for scientists or economists from ACIAR partner countries who are currently or recently involved in ACIAR research projects. It funds Masters by Research or PhD study at an Australian tertiary institution and is administered through the Australia Awards system, with ACIAR providing additional pastoral care and professional development. The Fellowship is the largest investment in ACIAR's Capacity Development Program.

title: Vice Chancellor's International Scholarship (Griffith University)
funding: Tuition Fee Waiver (50% of tuition fees)
duration: Valid for the whole degree, subject to meeting ongoing enrolment requirements
description: Griffith University awards its Vice Chancellor's International Scholarship to a limited number of exceptional new international students commencing undergraduate or postgraduate coursework programs. The award covers 50% of coursework tuition fees for the duration of the degree. Applicants must already hold an offer of a place from Griffith by the scholarship closing date and apply separately for the scholarship. The Trimester 1 2027 application window closes on 28 November 2026.

title: International Academic Merit Scholarship (Griffith University)
funding: Tuition Fee Waiver (20% of tuition fees)
duration: Valid for the whole degree, subject to meeting ongoing eligibility requirements
description: Griffith University's International Academic Merit Scholarship gives eligible international students a 20% reduction in coursework tuition fees for the whole degree, with a lower entry GPA of 4.5 on a 7-point scale. No separate scholarship application is needed: Griffith assesses eligibility when the student applies to study and advises the outcome in the Letter of Offer under 'Tuition and other fees - Total program fees'. It applies to most undergraduate and postgraduate coursework programs, subject to a published exclusion list.

title: New Zealand Refugee Health Scholarship
degree: Bachelor's, Master's, Postgraduate Certificate, Postgraduate Diploma, Graduate Certificate, Graduate Diploma
official_source: Immigration New Zealand (Ministry of Business, Innovation and Employment)
program_type: Government scholarship (refugees and displaced students, health workforce)
duration: One academic year; recipients must reapply each year
description: The New Zealand Refugee Health Scholarship Programme was developed in 2025 by the National Leadership and Coordination Service, a partnership between MBIE / Immigration New Zealand, the Ministry of Health and Health New Zealand, to create more equitable access to health-related education and training for former refugees. Each successful applicant receives a scholarship valued up to $25,000 for one academic year.

title: Massey University Doctoral Scholarship
description: Massey University Doctoral Scholarships are awarded to high-achieving students to provide financial support for their doctoral study, and Massey describes the award as 'a scholarship for a stipend plus fees' - a $30,000 annual stipend plus payment of tuition and non-tuition fees. The scholarships are open to New Zealand and international doctoral candidates in the PhD, DClinPsych and DSW, with named scholarships for Maori and Pacific doctoral candidates.

title: AUT Doctoral Scholarship
duration: Up to three years of full-time study, or up to six years of part-time study at a half-rate stipend

title: Government Scholarship in Saudi Public Universities for Non-Saudi Students (external scholarship) - Ministry of Education, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
degree: Bachelor's, Master's, PhD, Higher Diploma, Diploma in Arabic for non-native speakers
funding: Government scholarship, coverage varies by university
official_source: Ministry of Education, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (Study in Saudi platform)
duration: Programme length follows the degree studied; the Ministry page sets age ceilings of 25 for undergraduate and Arabic-diploma study, 30 for master's and 35 for doctoral study
description: The Saudi Ministry of Education runs a government scholarship programme that lets non-Saudi students study at the Kingdom's 27 public universities. Applicants apply directly to a Saudi public university for admission, or through the Saudi Cultural Attache in their country, or through the Saudi Embassy where no Cultural Attache exists. The Ministry classifies awards as external scholarships for students from outside the Kingdom, or internal scholarships for non-Saudis already holding legal residence in the Kingdom.
